name: visa_check_photo
description: Review Schengen visa photo requirements and common rejection reasons at TLScontact. Returns the full 35×45 mm ICAO specification, the 15 most common rejection reasons, and personalised advice based on photo method and whether the applicant wears glasses or a head covering. A non-compliant photo at TLS means rebooking the appointment.

photo_method.description: How the photo was taken: professional studio, self/DIY, or photo booth

has_glasses.description: Whether the applicant wears glasses in the photo

wears_headcovering.description: Whether the applicant wears a head covering (religious coverings permitted; face must be fully visible)
